name: GAIA
intro: GAIA是一个为通用AI助手设计的基准测试，旨在评估AI在现实世界问题中的表现。这些问题需要推理、多模态处理、网页浏览和工具使用等基本能力。GAIA的问题对人类来说概念简单，但对最先进的AI来说极具挑战性，旨在推动通用人工智能（AGI）的发展。
eval_feature: 思维链, 零样本, 多模态, 工具使用, 网页浏览
eval_feature_en: Chain-of-Thought, Zero-shot, Multimodal, Tool Use, Web Browsing
intro_en: GAIA is a benchmark designed for general AI assistants to evaluate their performance on real-world problems. These problems require core abilities such as reasoning, multimodal processing, web browsing, and tool use. GAIA’s tasks are conceptually simple for humans but highly challenging for state-of-the-art AI, aiming to advance the development of artificial general intelligence (AGI).

drawio_review_note:
Aligned with arXiv:2311.12983. GAIA is built from 466 human-designed and annotated real-world assistant questions. Questions are conceptually simple for humans but require reasoning, multimodal file handling, web browsing, coding, or tool use; many include attached evidence such as spreadsheets, images, PDFs, or web pages. The benchmark records capability metadata and sorts questions into three levels by required steps and tool diversity. Answers are intentionally concise, factoid, and unambiguous, and the evaluation prompts assistants in a zero-shot setting. Model outputs are normalized and compared with the ground-truth short answer using quasi exact match, reporting accuracy while releasing 166 annotated developer questions and keeping 300 answers for leaderboard evaluation.

Bilingual Draw.io bundle synchronized from benchmark_importer after paper and official-source review. The Chinese and English specs use identical node IDs, semantic types, coordinates, edges, and waypoints; strict Draw.io validation, XML and link checks, and rendered-image visual review passed before publication.
